Collision Devices browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive distortion browse by type distortion/fuzz/overdrive fuzz browse by enclosure pedal Collision Devices Collision Devices FZ - Gated Fuzz / Distortion Published on September 3, 2025 Collision Devices distortion fuzz gated pedal Information Description The Collision Devices FZ is a gated fuzz and distortion pedal built around four silicon transistor gain stages, designed to deliver a wide range of saturated textures. At lower gain settings it produces warm, round overdrive and classic rock grit, while higher settings unleash aggressive, shoegaze styled walls of fuzz and sputtery gated tones. A bias based gate control allows players to move from tight, choked fuzz to open sustaining sounds. A high frequency toggle shapes the pedal's top end, offering either cutting brightness or smoother rolled off highs. Part of Collision Devices' Sparks Series, the FZ is inspired by the Maestro Boss Tone and the fuzz section of the Black Hole Symmetry, while being developed and hand assembled by Collision Devices in France. Controls Gain: Adjusts the overall saturation, from low gain distortion to massive fuzz Gate: Bias control that sets the tightness of the fuzz response, from sputtery gated tones to open sustain High Frequency Toggle: Cuts or boosts treble frequencies to refine the tonal character Level: Sets the overall output volume Features Four stage silicon transistor fuzz circuit Wide gain range from distortion to shoegaze fuzz Bias based gate control for sputtery or sustaining response High frequency toggle for tonal shaping True bypass switching Hand assembled by Collision Devices Highlights Part of the Sparks Series, designed as an accessible entry into Collision Devices' pedal lineup Inspired by the Maestro Boss Tone and the fuzz circuit from the Black Hole Symmetry Capable of covering classic rock, grunge, gated noise, and shoegaze textures Combines DIY inspired design with professional build quality Specifications Pedal type: Gated fuzz and distortion Circuit: Four silicon transistor stages Power: 9V DC, center negative Switching: True bypass Dimensions: standard compact enclosure size Origin: Designed and assembled by Collision Devices, France Video all | by manufacturer | not by manufacturer Date ▼▲ Make
